title: ayapana squarrosa
intro: Ayapana squarrosa, commonly known as "Blackroot" or "Cachipora," is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ayapana squarrosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Ayapana squarrosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
